nom: SUNDAY RILEY Good Genes All-In-One Lactic Acid Treatment

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the product controls oil and reduces breakouts, with one calling it a solution for oil control that also faded dark spots.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or very dry skin report the product fixes dry patches and improves texture without stripping, and one with balanced-to-dry skin says texture is her main concern it addresses.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it clears acne, fades hyperpigmentation and dark circles, and works well alongside breakout-prone or acne-scarred skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report it is generally non-irritating and calming, though some warn of tingling, burning, or that it may be too strong for sensitive users, and one had a reaction attributed to aloe.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature skin (40s-70s) report visible reduction in fine lines and wrinkles, firmer and brighter skin, and a more youthful look over weeks of use.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report reduced fine lines, wrinkles, and firmer, more youthful-looking skin, including a 70-year-old and a 50-something reviewer; effects are described as gradual over weeks rather than immediate for most.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dry-complicated skin report improved plumpness, moisture retention, and relief from dry patches after use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report reduced or calmed redness and even skin tone; one reviewer instead noted increased redness after use, so responses are not uniform.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes it as non-stripping and gentle even when paired with a barrier-protecting cream, but another cautions it can be too strong or cause burning if applied to broken or irritated skin.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, melasma, and post-acne marks, often within days to a few weeks; one reviewer notes it takes longer to see change on dark spots/scars.
concerns.blemishes: Numerous reviewers report clearer skin and fading acne or cystic scars, including sporadic-breakout users; one reviewer notes that daily use actually triggers breakouts for her, and another got irritated bumps from an ingredient reaction.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers report the product reduces oiliness and associated breakouts, describing it as effective for oil control alongside spot-fading.

aspects.libelle: Packaging hides less product than it appears
Leaves skin soft, smooth and glowing
Noticeable tingling or stinging on application

extraits.titre: Very Good Product on 2nd mth - Not so good Packaging
extraits.texte: I have tried probably over a couple dozen Lactic Acid products. I have sensitive skin, combinations also with sun damage from my 20's. I am in my early 50's now with minimal fine lines around my eyes but had strong frown line between eyes. I have used it for a month with the CEO cream and I have seen a difference. There is a younger feel, brighter glow and a more youthful overall look to my skin. Give the product a chance at least a month remember this is a skin product not the fountain of youth. You have to set a realistic expectation from your skin care routine. Also this product is for under, around your eyes and up to your brow if you have sensitive skin do not put it on your eyelids. But from someone who has tried many products expensive and less expensive I like this product I see change in my skin texture, color, dullness, reduces puffiness to a degree(I think that took a little longer) and even fine lines. I gave it 4 stars only because of the packaging I have learned when the bottle is out of pumps it doesnt mean the bottle is empty I opened it up and found more inside so I took off one star for that.

extraits.titre: I wish I hated this product
extraits.texte: I am not one to write reviews but I have no choice but to with this one. Let me preface by saying my skin hates EVERYTHING. All SPF, all moisturizer, all face washes, masks, etc., will make me break out in tiny pimples. I have combination skin with pock marks and dark red spots from cysts many years ago that seem like theyll never fade. I got a sample of this product with my birthday code, and it has CHANGED. MY. LIFE. I'm not sure what kind of witchcraft and sorcery they mixed into this serum, but I will never be able to go without it again. Believe me, if there was ANYTHING comparable for even half the price I'd be purchasing that instead, but this is one of a kind. It brightens my skin, leaves it soft and plump, and is FADING MY ACNE SPOTS. I use one full pump for my whole face, and any extra residue drips I kind of press into my deepest pock marks. Complete magic. The issue is that the price tag is painful, borderline unreasonable…however, I tell myself it's still cheaper than dermatologist appointments, multiple trials of products that don't work and end up going to waste, and therapy (kidding). As always, what works for me may not work for you. Definitely get a sample and test it for a few days before committing to the full size. But if it ends up working for you, I can guarantee you will be coming back.

Unfortunately for my wallet this product works amazingly well. I've actually just emptied my 3rd bottle. I have pretty balanced to dry skin, my main skin concern is always texture. This product will take my skin from the crustiest depths to clear skin. People always compliment skin and this is the one product I have consistently used for 4 years. There's nothing like it.
I'm 40 with sensitive skin and larger pores and uneven redness. I got this as a free sample and love it. I ordered a large version of it soon after using it. Great product. My skin is even and calm.

I spent a lot of time debating trying this product because it is quite expensive, however I have very dry complicated skin. I have texture and fine lines coming through and my skin has changed since having kids. I've noticed more signs of aging and decided to try this instead of a retinol type product because it seem to fit more what I was looking for. I started using it as suggested for sensitive skin, after my first week I began using it as a leave on serum and my skin has never looked better. I paired this with other products that have peptides (matriculated multi peptide on days I'm not using this and a barrier protector type cream on the days I am) and so far I'm noticing a huge difference in the texture and fine lines and plumpness of my skin as well as moisture retention a big part of that has been using this every other day. On days where I wake up and maybe I've been lazy and my skin has started to show it dullness again, I've been using it in the morning, waiting a few minutes before applying any other skin care, and it revives my skin instantly! as a tired mom I think that's a pretty cool trick.

I recieved a tester with a purchase, and then was like "hmm well let me try a little more" so i bought the "go to bed with me" set to see if it was still just as good, and then i decided it was time to stop playing around and bought the full size. this product is AMAZING! It can be used every day, (its a little tingly) but i have sensitive/combo/ acne prone skin and its now a staple in my rountine. (Sometimes when im lazy its the only thing in my routine.) I honestly can't say enough good things about it. It combats my oily skin, my acne, leaves my face bright and smooth! If you're thinking about buying it, just do it.

This serum has really changed things for my skin. I don't use it every day but it works almost immediately and makes my skin even and glowing. When I have a big event or something I want to look my best at this is what I turn to. If I use it every day it does make me break out.
